hero.title: Good Omens — Series Finale (90-min episode)
hero.about: The third and final chapter of Good Omens, reshaped from a six-episode S3 into one 90-minute feature after Neil Gaiman's departure. Picks up where S2 left off: angel Aziraphale (Michael Sheen) and demon Crowley (David Tennant) are estranged after Aziraphale accepts the offer to return to Heaven. Premieres in 240+ countries simultaneously. Returning ensemble — Doon Mackichan, Gloria Obianyo, Liz Carr, Quelin Sepulveda, Derek Jacobi as the Metatron; Bilal Hasna joins as Jesus.
hero.why: Tier 1 hero — direct Loved-list continuation dropping inside the 4-week window. Dry British humor + supernatural + LGBTQ+ ensemble is the exact stack you reward (S1 and S2 are on your Loved list). 90 minutes is a perfect bedtime watch — one sitting, story closed.

new_this_week.title: Good Omens — Series Finale
new_this_week.about: Final 90-min chapter of Good Omens. Reshaped from a 6-ep S3 into one feature after Gaiman departure. Sheen and Tennant return as Aziraphale and Crowley; full supporting cast back; Bilal Hasna joins as Jesus.
new_this_week.why: Loved-list continuation. (Also today's hero pick — see top.)

new_this_week.title: Devil May Cry S2
new_this_week.date: Tue May 12, 2026 — TODAY, all 8 eps drop
new_this_week.about: Adi Shankar adult-animation series, Studio Mir animating (Legend of Korra, Voltron). S2 launches the Dante–Vergil rivalry with a darker, more personal arc. 8 episodes binge-drop today. S1 hit Netflix Top 10 with 5.3M views in 3 days and earned 96% RT. Returning cast: Johnny Yong Bosch (Dante), Robbie Daymond (Vergil), Scout Taylor-Compton (Lady).
new_this_week.why: Adult animation + supernatural + 30-min episodes triple-stacks your signals — same shelf as Solar Opposites. Studio Mir's craft is reliable and S2 is the Dante–Vergil collision S1 set up. Drops today — clean binge.

new_this_week.title: The Boys S5 (Final) — Ep 7 (Penultimate)
new_this_week.date: Wed May 13, 2026 — TOMORROW; finale Wed May 20
new_this_week.about: Penultimate episode of the final season — 'The Frenchman, the Female, and the Man Called Mother's Milk' drops 3am ET tomorrow. Eighth and final episode lands May 20. Season has been tracking ~95% RT.
new_this_week.why: On your watchlist. Last two weeks of the show — endgame momentum + dark satire + plot escalation aligns directly with your reward signals.

new_this_week.title: Widow's Bay — Ep 4 'Beach Reads'
new_this_week.about: Ep 4 'Beach Reads' shifts the spotlight to Patricia, whose painful past hints at one of the cursed island's darkest secrets. Tone is more somber than earlier episodes. Matthew Rhys-led, Katie Dippold creator.
new_this_week.why: On your watchlist. Last week was the hero pick — Ep 4 keeps the cadence. Katie Dippold (The Heat) wrote/created, which is a direct Loved-list connection.

new_this_week.title: Your Friends & Neighbors S2 — Ep 7
new_this_week.about: Ep 7 of the 10-episode second season. Jon Hamm continues as the hedge fund manager-turned-thief working his way through suburban neighbors' homes; weekly Friday rollout. Season finale lands June 4.
new_this_week.why: On your watchlist. Dark comedy + suburban-crime escalation + plot twists keeps it inside your reward pattern.

new_this_week.title: BEEF S2
new_this_week.about: Lee Sung Jin's Emmy-sweeping anthology resets with new cast and story: Oscar Isaac, Carey Mulligan, Charles Melton, Cailee Spaeny. Two couples at a Montecito beach club — the younger pair blackmails the older after a violent fight. Eight ~30-min eps binge-dropped. 86% RT.
new_this_week.why: S1 rewarded the exact things you reward — dark humor, plot escalation, ensemble acting. Anthology reset means no S1 baggage.

new_this_week.title: Lord of the Flies
new_this_week.date: May 4 — now streaming, all 4 eps available
new_this_week.about: Four-episode BBC/Netflix miniseries from Emmy-winner Jack Thorne (Adolescence, His Dark Materials), adapting Golding's novel. Marc Munden directs. THR: 'very close to a definitive adaptation.'
new_this_week.why: Book adaptation is a positive signal; psychological pressure-cooker has plot-twist potential. 92% RT but audience is mixed (57%) — critics rewarded the prestige craft, audience found it bleak. Try the first ep before committing.

new_this_week.title: La Brea S1–4
new_this_week.about: Network sci-fi mystery (originally NBC, 2021–2024) — a massive sinkhole opens in Los Angeles, pulling people and buildings into a prehistoric land. Full four-season run dropped May 1 as a binge package.
new_this_week.why: Sci-fi premise + world building + complete run checks three reward signals. Network-pacing means commercial-break beats — try one ep to see if the writing carries it past 'try.'

new_this_week.title: Apex
new_this_week.about: Charlize Theron plays Sasha, an experienced climber grieving the loss of her partner; alone in the Australian wilderness, what begins as endurance becomes a cat-and-mouse hunt with a methodical predator (Taron Egerton). Baltasar Kormákur directs. Eric Bana co-stars.
new_this_week.why: Pure survival thriller — strong premise but no off-beat humor or sci-fi/supernatural angle to push it past 'try.' Good if you specifically want a tense one-night watch.

new_this_week.title: Kevin
new_this_week.about: Aubrey Plaza and Joe Wengert's animated series. Jason Schwartzman voices Kevin, a housecat who decides to try life without people; Plaza voices Dana, one of the humans he leaves behind. All 8 eps dropped at once.
new_this_week.why: On your watchlist. Adult animation + off-beat humor + 30-min episodes triple-stacks your signals — same pocket as Solar Opposites and Rick and Morty.

new_this_week.title: The House of the Spirits
new_this_week.about: Eight-part adaptation of Isabel Allende's 1982 novel. Multi-generational Trueba family saga in Chile blending political turmoil with magical realism. First three eps Apr 29; finale May 13. 80% RT.
new_this_week.why: Book adaptation + magical-realism elements hit positive signals; Spanish-language watch is a Spanish-tutor side-benefit. Multi-generational drama is heavier than your usual — try ep 1.

new_this_week.title: Chainsaw Man — The Movie: Reze Arc
new_this_week.about: First feature-length film in MAPPA's Chainsaw Man series. Adapts manga chapters 39–52 (the entire Reze Arc) — Denji's romance with a barista who is not what she seems. Crunchyroll's Ani-May celebration. Both sub and dub available.
new_this_week.why: Dark humor + supernatural + plot-twist machinery + MAPPA's animation. Reze Arc is widely considered the best self-contained Chainsaw Man story — works as a standalone.

new_this_week.title: Witch Hat Atelier
new_this_week.about: Long-awaited adaptation of Kamome Shirahama's manga. Coco, a young girl who dreams of becoming a witch, gets her chance after a chance encounter with a traveling magician. Heavy on world building and visual craft.
new_this_week.why: Fantasy anime with strong world building hits your sweet spot. Coming-of-age tone is lighter than usual, but the magic-system rigor scratches the same itch as Foundation/Sandman.

new_this_week.title: Dorohedoro S2
new_this_week.about: Long-delayed S2 of the cult-favorite manga adaptation. Caiman, a man with a reptile head and amnesia, hunts the sorcerer who cursed him. Vibe: gruesome but absurdly funny, with deep world building.
new_this_week.why: Dark humor + supernatural + off-beat — three of your strongest signals stacked. Body-horror visuals are gnarly but they're load-bearing for the comedy.

new_this_week.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
new_this_week.date: May 20 — premieres with 2 eps, weekly through Jul 15
new_this_week.about: Darkly comedic thriller from David J. Rosen. Tatiana Maslany plays Paula, a newly divorced mom who falls into a rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer. 10 eps, half-hour, premieres with two eps May 20 then weekly Wednesdays through July 15.
new_this_week.why: Dark comedy-thriller + 30-min episodes + Maslany's Orphan Black ensemble pedigree triple-stacks your reward signals. Flag now so it's on your radar.

new_this_week.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
new_this_week.about: Feature film continuation of the Prime Video series. John Krasinski returns as Jack Ryan, with Wendell Pierce and Michael Kelly back from the show; Sienna Miller joins. Ryan is reluctantly thrust back into espionage when a covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy.
new_this_week.why: Action-thriller lane — you 4⭐'d M:I Final Reckoning so 'entertaining + hi-tech' espionage works. No supernatural/sci-fi anchor — stays at 'try.'

new_this_week.title: The Boroughs
new_this_week.date: May 21 — all 8 episodes drop at once
new_this_week.about: Sci-fi/supernatural series with the Duffer Brothers as EPs; Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews showrun. Set in a New Mexico retirement community where seniors must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time. Cast: Bill Pullman, Alfre Woodard, Alfred Molina, Geena Davis. 8-ep binge.
new_this_week.why: Supernatural + world building + ensemble cast triple-stacks your signals; Duffer pedigree means a real plot-twist machine. 'Stranger Things for seniors' framing is the off-beat hook you reward.

new_this_week.title: Ladies First
new_this_week.about: Sacha Baron Cohen vs. Rosamund Pike in a gender-swap satire — a high-powered ad exec wakes up in a parallel world where women hold all the power, going head-to-head with the underestimated Alex Fox (Pike) for the top job. Thea Sharrock directs.
new_this_week.why: Alt-reality + satirical comedy + Baron Cohen's commit flirts with your off-beat sweet spot. Satire is Solar Opposites territory. No supernatural anchor — stays at 'try.'

critics.about: Reshaped 90-min finale wrapping the Aziraphale–Crowley arc after Gaiman's departure. RT critic embargo lifts at premiere; this is the week's top-anticipated finale and a direct Loved-list payoff.
critics.why: Hero pick — finale of a Loved-list show, on a service you have. Tomorrow's must-watch.

critics.title: Lord of the Flies
critics.about: Jack Thorne 4-episode adaptation of Golding. THR: 'very close to a definitive adaptation.' Critics 92% / audience 57%.
critics.why: Highest-RT new drop on a service you have this month. Book adaptation lands; tonal darkness is the watch-out — see new this week.

critics.title: Jo Nesbø's Detective Hole
critics.about: Nine-episode Norwegian crime series adapting Nesbø's fifth Harry Hole novel, The Devil's Star. Tobias Santelmann is the brooding lead detective; Joel Kinnaman co-stars. Currently a global Netflix top-10. RT consensus calls it 'twisty, stylish, and at times gloriously grim.'
critics.why: Nordic noir with plot twists, ensemble acting, brooding-detective DNA — directly adjacent to the Slow Horses lane you 4⭐'d. Subs needed; you're open to that.
